x-e-e5-06.material:
Loro pengumuman Swim Day saka sekolah Mina.

Pengumuman A (kantor sekolah)
Swim Day. Tanggal: Friday, June 7.
Kumpul: gapura sekolah, 8:30 a.m.
Gawanen: baju renang, andhuk, tutup sirah renang.

Pengumuman B (guru kelas)
Swim Day dianakake Friday, June 7. Bis mangkat jam 9:00 a.m. Mangga nggawa baju renang lan andhuk. Yen udan, kita lunga tanggal June 14.
